scope: Typed operator objects and safe reference nullability widening; optimized-project prefix only

attempted_shard.reason: SQL-defined ExternalFunction expensive requires typed body and parameter-scope transport

repairs: Operator object IDs are distinct from instantiated call signatures.
Type constructors preserve declared type identity, qualified names, quoting and absent/present component positions.
Row constructors preserve absent field-name lists and explicit lists with null entries.
Builtin singleton identity and equal distinct dynamic objects remain distinct.
Field references may widen outer nullability and retain equal distinct type objects; nested IDs and nominal identity remain strict.
limitations: This is a 527-case project-only prefix, not a full-shard or full-corpus pass.
SQL function bodies require a combined operator/expression dependency graph and isolated parameter scopes; they remain unsupported.
Whole-program statement, catalog, relational sharing and detached S1-to-S2 transport remain open.
The type-shape check retains exact nested IDs and is not general structural type equivalence or SQL type inference.
Collated constructor identifiers and specialized Rex subclasses remain explicitly unsupported.
